scope_groups.header: Building Signage - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:
items: Supply and install all building signage including all interior and exterior building signage; identification, wayfinding, and code compliant signage; and emergency exit maps as detailed and specified.
Includes room and door signs, electrical room signs, restroom signs, exit signs, room max occupancy signs, fire department connection sign, and no smoking signs where indicated.
Includes emergency exit maps posted in each room showing the exit route, as required by the Fire Marshal.
Coordinate backing requirements and layout with Framing Subcontractor.
Signage at exterior walls and all exterior locations shall be exterior rated.

scope_groups.header: Exterior Lettering - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:
items: Supply and install 24 inch high exterior mounted, aluminum lettering per Keynote 6-04/A5-10.
Lettering includes TONOPAH HIGH SCHOOL HOME OF THE MUCKERS.
Includes all concealed anchors and fasteners as required for a complete installation.
Includes painted finish color as selected by Architect

scope_groups.header: Menu Display Case - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:
items: Supply and install exterior mounted Menu Display Case per Keynote 6-01/A5-10.
Includes all anchors and fasteners as required for a complete installation.

exclusions: Mascot mural and painted school logo graphics
